reviews.title: Ads in the middle of the game
reviews.text: Everything that is locked pops up an ad that stops my toddler from playing. When I need a 5 minute break and I hand my kiddo my phone I shouldn’t have to get it back every 10 seconds because every other buttons pops up a pay wall.

reviews.title: Can’t restore my purchase
reviews.text: I can’t restore my purchase and the customer support is nonexistent

reviews.title: Great but needs a tweak
reviews.text: Great app but after I paid for the full version, I realized they put the featured apps in the bottom right corner really big in an attractive to push button for my toddler. She pushes that more than any other button and can’t figure out how to go back. Should get rid of that tab and put those settings in the top left under the parent section. If I pay, I should have to look at your other paid apps the whole time.

reviews.title: How I am way too old
reviews.text: I fought this game was gonna be really fun and have a lot of violence inside really it’s just some stupid baby game that if you want full stuff, you just have to pay a subscription. I do not have any money and I’ve thought this was going to be fun.

reviews.title: Worrying
reviews.text: I downloaded this game for my 18 month old who loves phones however I was seriously considered when I looked at him whilst playing it and my front camera was on and he was on what looked like a FaceTime call to a frog who then repeated every noise that was made. GAMES MADE FOR BABIES AND KIDS SHOULD NOT USE CAMERAS OR MICROPHONES

reviews.title: May Encourage dangerous behaviour
reviews.text: In The pirate video call the water rises which would drown the poor pirate but I think this is a silly thing to put in a kids game and should be removed

reviews.title: Ads even on paid version
reviews.text: There are ads even after paying. Constantly pressing the button and requiring a parent to close it. Very annoying. Also what’s with all these fake reviews?

reviews.title: Why?
reviews.text: There’s nothing fun about this app
